product_one_liner.value: Trackforce provides physical-security workforce management software for security companies and organizations to manage guard forces and improve security operations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as a SaaS platform for physical-security workforce management, serving security companies and organizations and helping them manage guard forces and operations.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page explains how customers request a tailored quote and describes selectable product modules. A public pricing page counts even though it does not list fixed prices.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The Airbus case study says Trackforce was selected as provider. The cited press release identifies St. Moritz Security Services Inc.'s CTO and quotes his comments about Trackforce's product. | named_customers.0: The case study identifies Airbus as a customer selected after a tender and proof of concept. | named_customers.1: The cited Trackforce announcement identifies St. Moritz Security Services Inc.'s CTO commenting on the product and its use.

employee_band.notes: The cited company profile gives the size band as 201-500.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The cited profile gives the headquarters as Southlake, Texas, and the contact page confirms the Southlake, United States address. | hq_country: The contact page identifies the United States office in Southlake, Texas.

founded_year.notes: The cited company profile directly states Trackforce was founded in 2000.

eng_blog.notes: The index presents practical security-operations articles, including industry and product-use topics, and does not show posts about how Trackforce engineers build the product. On the available index evidence, it does not meet the requirement for an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The public help center provides multiple product sections, developer tools, release notes, and policies/resources, meeting the public-documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page says there are two open roles, and the listed titles are Enterprise Sales Director and Major Accounts Account Manager; neither is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: The AI policy discusses storage in Amazon S3 and says Trackforce and AWS do not review user content; the DPA lists subprocessors, including AWS. These sources do not identify an AI model or name AWS as the AI model provider, so the provider is unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The cited page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR. ISO 27017 is also named there but is not one of the requested list categories. | compliance_certs.0: The page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.1: The page explicitly names ISO 27001. | compliance_certs.2: The page explicitly says GDPR compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding history labels the latest round Growth Equity. | funding_date: The funding history dates the most recent listed round to September 2019, formatted as 2019-09. | funding_amount_usd: The funding history lists a $150.0M Growth Equity round in September 2019; this is 150,000,000 USD.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding history identifies September 2019 as the most recent round, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026; therefore the answer is false.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Account Executive posting includes an application link, supporting that Trackforce is hiring for an AE role.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 2026 release notes list substantive product additions, including a dedicated Lone Worker screen and app check-in prompts, within the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Trackforce announced Scott Kaine's appointment as CEO on January 12, 2026, within the 12 months before the specified date.
